ADDENDUM NO. 1 - SOLICITATION SV-TRANS-2026-044
Sun Valley Regional Transit Authority - Electric Transit Bus Charging Infrastructure Upgrade
Date of Issuance: October 12, 2026
The Purpose of this Addendum is to modify solicitation requirements and extend the proposal timeline.
1. PROPOSAL DEADLINE EXTENSION:
The proposal submission deadline is hereby extended from October 22, 2026 at 2:00 PM EST to October 29, 20
2. INSTALLATION TIMELINE ADJUSTMENT:
The installation and commissioning period is extended from 90 days to 120 days from Notice to Proceed.
3. BID SECURITY ADJUSTMENT:
The required bid security bond is adjusted from 5% to 3% of the total proposal amount.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS REMAIN UNCHANGED.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & HARDWARE SCHEDULE - SV-TRANS-2026-044
Sun Valley Regional Transit Authority
Product Name: Commercial Bus DC Fast Charger
Model Number: EVX-FC180 Dual-Port DC Fast Charger
Part Number / SKU: EVX-180-CCS1-480V
Requested Quantity: 24 Units
Manufacturer for Registration: EVX Power Systems
Key Technical Specifications:
- Output Power: 180 kW continuous DC output with dynamic power sharing
- Input Power: 480V AC 3-Phase, 60Hz
- Connectors: Dual liquid-cooled CCS Type 1 dispensing cables (7-meter length)
- Network Protocol: OCPP 2.0.1 JSON compliant with automated transit fleet management integration
- Environmental Rating: NEMA 3R / IP65 outdoor enclosure rating
- Operating Temperature: -30C to +50C
- Warranty: 5-Year Full Comprehensive On-Site Parts and Labor Manufacturer Warranty
